name: Hologram Studio 3D
description: Real 3D (three.js) holograms in a dark studio: translucent iridescent objects with glowing cyan rims hover over a round projector pad with concentric light rings and a faint light cone, drawn upward by a scan plane, with rising data motes, bloom, depth fog, scanlines, HUD rulers and a dot grid. Titles are thin glowing caps in corner brackets whose kicker rolls from garbage glyphs into text; scenes swap through thinning scanlines. Futuristic and precise. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 6-10 scenes (3-5 s each). Every scene has title.kicker + title.main and visual.type "scene3d" with 1-4 objects (chip, server, database, lock, key, globe, phone, monitor, gear, stat, chart...). One object = a hero scan; use focus to push in on a part and stat for big numbers. Short labels (1-3 words). Never use emoji.
